infografia.prompt_final: Premium 3D iconography for a B2B fintech ad about industrial equipment pricing and FX impact. A refined white industrial motor as the hero object sits above and slightly overlapping a clean purchase quotation sheet, visually connecting the visible current cost to its future variation. Show a side-by-side cost breakdown with minimal, elegant 3D elements: one clean document card, one subtle FX rate ring or curved arrow, and one small secondary industrial component. Use a white studio background with lots of negative space, soft contact shadows, matte ceramic and satin acrylic materials, precise rounded edges, and a premium institutional finish. Palette must be mostly white and light gray, with navy structural accents, teal as the dominant activation color, and a single coral highlight for the cost tension point. Composition should read in under 3 seconds, with one clear hero object, maximum 1–3 supporting elements, clean comparative graphics, and a clear contrast between opacity from the bank side and clarity from Xending. Modern, corporate, international, trustworthy, minimal, high-end, isometric three-quarter camera, 45–70 mm equivalent lens, softbox lighting, no pedestal, no collage, no flat vector look.
infografia.negative_instructions: No text, no letters, no numbers, no labels, no logos, no watermarks, no invented data, no fake UI text, no gibberish, no misspellings, no third-party brands. No clutter, no generic Canva infographic, no three-column layout, no catalog grid, no excessive elements, no inconsistent scale, no childish toy look, no inflatable object, no cheap plastic, no low-poly rendering, no glass-heavy look, no neon, no crypto, no gamer aesthetic. No dark background, no excessive navy, no excessive teal, no excessive coral, no thick arrows, no too many routes, no dashboard crowded with modules. No malformed motor, no unrealistic industrial machine, no boxy or toy-like equipment, no flat vector design, no exaggerated bloom, no messy shadows, no AI-generated artifacts.
infografia.creative_rationale: The hero motor becomes the visual bridge between a quoted price and its future FX-driven change, which directly translates the headline and body into a clear premium fintech infographic. The clean side-by-side cost logic reinforces Xending’s promise of clarity versus bank opacity while staying minimal, corporate, and readable.
